question: What native fragment depth and panel overlap are present across the complete main and extended mm10 exports before experimental comparisons?
decision: Preserve full-library denominators and literal barcode panel rows for Stage 1 specimen qualification. No donor or exposure contrast.
strongest_rival: Selection of 63 sites, tissue and culture composition, shared technical runs, missing or ambiguous samples, variable depth and lack of independent state labels can restrict an eventual comparison.
discriminator: Complete chromosome-sorted original BGZF streams supply usable denominators and distinguish an unobserved region from an uninspected region.
exposure_record: Original paper, Table 6 binding interpretation, S0-S6 and deposit review were known. Stage 1 examines presence, units, depth and missingness. No association or between-arm effect was inspected or estimated.
biological_unit: Native ATAC and tissue methylation use mice, separate organoid methylation uses source-labelled mouse lines. Binding uses paired sequences with one library per protein condition. Reads, CpGs, loci, barcodes and technical pools are nested observations.
nesting_and_overlap: Deduplicate shared specimen/donor accessions across technical records. Do not pool tissue and organoid cohorts. Full and extended ATAC exports are distinct technical sources, with original within-cohort controls preferred.
population_and_selection: All rows of both IGVF exports, every chromosome and literal export barcode. Only panel-extract rows are restricted to overlap with any original amplicon.
contrast: Technical scan of complete source records. No condition is compared.
endpoint: Per-raw-barcode distinct fragment counts, autosomal depth, mitochondrial count, source read support, repeated identical rows and deduplicated target-overlap rows.
methods: Read complete BGZF streams with CRC checking, validate coordinate sort and columns, coalesce matching chromosome,start,end,barcode within each export. Use half-open overlap and retain full raw target rows. Record chromosome 1-19 autosomal counts and mitochondrial depth separately. Preserve raw identifiers and technical multiplicity.
missingness_and_exclusions: No barcode or donor selection based on region signal. Exclude repeated identical native fragment records only from unique counts. Original tabix sidecars were absent at the checked public sibling URLs; full sequential parsing avoids requiring an index.
multiplicity: No tests, effect estimates, outcome selection or rankings. Retain all 63 intervals and all original samples including unavailable cases.
precision_basis: Technical coverage and presence only. No biological precision or power estimated.
interpretation_limit: Source qualification does not identify cellular state, occupancy, retained protein, methylation causality, biochemical interaction strength or change after exposure.
stop_rule: Stop on source size/hash mismatch, malformed row, unsorted chromosome/start or incomplete stream. Continue only to Stage 1 coverage qualification.
amendment_reason: Owner-requested source and coverage qualification after S6. Separate Stage 1 metadata receipt.
